title: Second special sitting of 2024

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2024/ޚޞ/2).
Preliminary debate on the bill amending Law No. 7/2023 (Companies Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Feydhoo North MP Ismail Nizar.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The second special sitting was scheduled to debate a government bill amending the Companies Act and then vote.
